summary: Practise construction cost plans, rate build-ups, change valuation and forecast reporting. Explore the five-day course and its applied curriculum.
lede: Quantity surveying and cost management apply measured construction information to budgeting, valuation and cost forecasting. For quantity surveyors, cost engineers and commercial managers, the course builds practical skills for preparing and reviewing cost plans and explaining changes as design and site conditions evolve. Through construction case exercises and Excel schedules, learners check quantities against RICS New Rules of Measurement, build rates, assess changes and report forecast final cost.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who prepare, check or use construction quantities, cost plans, valuations and forecast reports in building or infrastructure projects.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with construction drawings, bills of quantities or project cost reports is expected. No programming is required; you will use Excel for cost schedules and reporting exercises.
